vb_textbox.text: I noticed that the gnomes work in pairs. That is, when the brown gnome gives 6+ mushrooms, the green gnome will also give around 6 + mushrooms. The other pairing is the pink and purple gnomes. The pairs will take turns to give a good number of mushrooms (6+); however, these periods are followed by a transition period where both pairs give less than 5 mushrooms. I followed a rule that if I got 3 pickings in a row that were below 5 mushrooms, I switched to the other pair until this no longer happened. Do not worry; you will learn and feel when the changing pairs are necessary. Basically, if green is good, then brown should be good, too, and if purple is good, then pink should also be good. You need to try not to get too caught out with the transitions give it a few chances before switching pairing).I hope you will enjoy the game, otherwise, you would feel very boring :)
